name: Hakuouki Reimeiroku
source: Years before the beginning of Hakuouki, the Shinsengumi was known as the Mibu Roushigumi.  A wandering young man named Ibuki Ryuunosuke falls in with the group by chance just after they first come to Kyoto, and while grudgingly making friends with the members within, witnesses the dawning era of the Shinsengumi.
translation: 在《薄櫻鬼》故事開始的數年前，新選組還被稱為壬生浪士組。一個名叫伊吹龍之介的流浪青年在他們初到京都時偶然加入了這個團體，在勉為其難地與成員們交朋友的同時，見證了新選組的黎明時代。
